Almost every bulb in my house has been converted to low-wattage LED bulbs. At any given time I'm using maybe 100w, or less, in lighting energy, while things like my furnace, A/C and large appliances make up the majority of my energy bill. LED replacement lamps have come down in price significantly over the past 5 years, so more and more people will be purchasing this technology, and using less electricity by upgrading their bulbs. I just saw a story the other day about how they've even increased the efficiency of certain incandescent bulbs, so even with "older technologies" I think we will, over time, see an overall decrease in energy usage.

EDIT: added word
